info.title: hydromart-digital notifications raised by machine accounts
info.description:
AI-5. Routes n8n calls, with a machine token, to raise a notification in hydromart-digital's own staff notifications: a row in the staff feed (the bell on the console) and a push to the phones of the accounts it is for. hydromart-digital writes the text itself (Indonesian, the product default); the caller sends facts, never copy.

Authentication: a machine token from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token (auth.openapi.json): ES256, aud hydromart-machine, 15 minutes. Each route names the capability its token's scopes must include. An AI-web token (aud hydromart-ai) is refused on these routes, whoever the person is, and so is any hydromart-digital session token whose role does not hold that capability.

Audit trail: every call is recorded in hydromart-digital's audit trail BEFORE it runs, as the machine account, with the request body, and refused with 503 when it cannot be recorded; nothing is notified then. Send X-Workflow to name the n8n workflow in that record.

Rate limit: counted per machine account (the token's sub), at the edge and again in the service; a 429 carries Retry-After.

Compatibility: unknown request fields are refused (400), so send only the fields listed. A field may be added to a response within version 1; removing or renaming one is a new contract version.

post.summary: Tell the people who review franchise applications that a calon mitra applied on /waralaba.
post.description:
Called by n8n for each verified franchise.application_submitted event (events.openapi.json), with that event's eventId and data. The token's scopes must include franchiseApplicationNotify.

Who is told: every account whose role holds the franchiseApplications capability (head office and the director by default; another role, Sales for one, once HQ gives it that capability at /hq/access). They see a row titled Lamaran waralaba baru in their staff notifications and get a push, unless they switched off the approvals push on their notification settings. The row and the push open the application, /hq/applications/detail?id=<applicationId>. A superuser account sees the row but is not pushed. Nobody else sees it.

Idempotent on eventId: a repeated eventId (a retry after a timeout, a replay of the event, in any letter case) answers 200 with the id of the notification the first call made, and nobody is notified twice. The first call's city and province are the ones shown.

city and province are shown as one line of plain text: control characters and runs of whitespace (newlines, tabs) become one space, invisible format characters (zero-width, bidirectional) are dropped, and the ends are trimmed. A value with nothing visible left is refused with 400.

parameters.name: X-Workflow
parameters.description: The n8n workflow making the call, recorded in the audit trail as workflow (trimmed, at most 120 characters). Not checked.

200.description: The notification exists: made by this call, or by an earlier call with the same eventId.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: a field missing, malformed or unknown; eventId that is not franchise.application_submitted:<applicationId> of the same request; city or province empty, longer than 100 characters, or with nothing visible left. Not worth retrying with the same body.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify. That includes every token after AI and machine access was switched off (the published key set is empty): POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token then answers 503. Get a new token, then retry.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a valid token that may not call this: an AI-web token, or a machine token whose scopes do not include franchiseApplicationNotify. Not worth retrying until the machine account's scopes change.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this machine account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry with the same body.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the audit trail could not record the call, so nothing was notified. Retry later with the same body; the eventId keeps a retry from notifying twice.

machineToken.description: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token. ES256, aud hydromart-machine; its scopes claim is the machine account's closed capability list.

eventId.description: The event's eventId, unchanged: franchise.application_submitted:<applicationId>. Letter case is ignored. The dedupe key.

applicationId.description: The event's data.applicationId. Must be the id inside eventId.

city.description: The event's data.city, unchanged (hydromart-digital cleans it, see the route description).

code.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RATE_LIMITED or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: For people reading logs. Route on statusCode and code.
